alertTypes.title: Alert types
alertTypes.description: AA means Allergy Alert, PRIN means Product Recall Information Notice, and FAFA means Food Alert for Action. An empty list includes all three.

allergens.title: Allergens
allergens.description: Match any exact FSA allergen label or notation, ignoring case. Examples include milk, Peanuts, and gluten. Leave empty to include all alerts.

since.title: Modified on or after
since.description: Optional UTC date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When set, this takes precedence over Days back.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Look for alerts modified in the last N days when no explicit date is supplied.

keywords.title: Title keywords
keywords.description: Include alerts whose titles contain any of these phrases, ignoring case. Leave empty to include all titles.

onlyNew.title: Monitor new and changed alerts
onlyNew.description: Emit each distinct alert version once per state key. The first run includes all matching alerts in the date window.

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Reuse this key for successive runs of one monitor. Use different keys for independent schedules or sets of filters.
